case.title: Follow-up 'any update??' on an existing thread
case.subject: Re: Google Calendar not syncing
case.text:
any update??

On Mon, 16 Nov 2026 at 10:12, Slotwise Support <support@slotwise.test> wrote:
> Thanks Tom, we're looking into the sync issue and will get back to you.
case.why: Almost no content of its own; context lives in the quoted thread. A chaser deserves review (and a bump in urgency), not a generic auto-reply or a promise of a fix date.

output.reply:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for following up, and sorry for the wait. I don't have a status update on your case yet, and I can't give a timeline, but a teammate will follow up with you directly.

In the meantime, here are some steps from our help center that may help:

1. Go to Profile → Calendar sync, click Disconnect, then click Connect Google Calendar again. Make sure you allow both permissions (view and edit events).
2. Check that the right calendar is ticked under "Calendars that block availability".
3. Make sure the time zone in Settings → Business details matches the one in Google Calendar.

If it still fails, please reply with the staff member's name and an example appointment so our team can check the sync log. You can also see live calendar sync status at status.slotwise.test.

Slotwise Support

raw.summary: Customer follows up asking for an update on a previously reported Google Calendar sync issue.
reasons: Model suggests a human look: Follow-up on an open ticket; an agent must check investigation status and give an update, which the help center cannot answer.
